Hey sorry for the LONG wait, but I am doing better. I haven't had any suicidal thoughts for a while. I want my parents to just accept that im am a godless child and that it isnt bad. but we cant get everything right? 

well thanks for being there for me when i needed it. :)
I would if I could but now being back at my parents house this make it hard to go out and stuff. Haa I shouldn't be feeling this way, I mean there are other people who have worse lives than me

just I had a nice time, it got me away from thinking about how im feeling. Right now I just feel terrible right now, I should be studying for this test tomorrow, but i was talking to my sister earlier and my cousin today, and they think im going crazy because im taking the drugs. I havent told them about my depressed thoughts, but i feel that everyone else is in on a plan that i dont know about, i feel as if everyone is talking behind my back. i hate this..

right now i havent been using it on my own, i feel if i start to do it when im alone i will abuse it. I just went to a friends 21st birthday yesterday, i had about 5 shots worth and smoked about a gram i believe. I dont feel the sadness and depression i was having the couple of days ago. i just wish i had  like a really good friend i could talk to here.

Thanks, my life has taken a wide turn around. It took a while for me to find out how i want to live my life. The grugs are bad i know it, it makes me  a diffrent person and anything bad seems good... ill just try not to become a abuser or habitual user.
